quarterly_data.quarter: Planet Labs press release: Planet's Pelican-12 Satellite Arrives at Launch Site (09-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Pelican-12, an updated second-generation (Gen 2) high-resolution Pelican, arrived at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station ahead of launch on SpaceX's upcoming Bandwagon-5 rideshare, shipping less than three months after Pelican-11 (launched in July) with updated payload and communication systems; Gen 2 Pelicans are designed for up to 30 cm class imagery versus 50 cm class for Gen 1. It carries a steerable antenna for intersatellite communications, aiming at two-way rates above the 1 Mbps achieved in an initial 2025 demonstration, as Planet tests commercial data relay services. It will be the fifth Pelican launched in 2026, and Planet plans to launch additional Pelicans in 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: fifth Pelican of 2026; up to 30 cm class imagery (Gen 2)
